articles.title: Standard-dose unfractionated heparin versus low-dose unfractionated heparin and low-molecular-weight heparin in extracorporeal life support (RATE): an open-label, randomised, non-inferiority trial
articles.authors: Minnen OV, Lansink-Hartgring AO, van Amstel RBE, van den Bogaard B, Bunge JJH, Delnoij TSR, Droogh JM, Koppenhagen LV, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: In patients receiving extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO), standard practice is full-dose intravenous unfractionated heparin (UFH) targeting an activated partial thromboplastin time of 2·0-2·5 times baseline to reduce thrombotic risk. This approach can increase bleeding without further reducing thrombosis compared with low-dose UFH. Robust evidence to guide anticoagulation targets is absent because anticoagulation targets in ECMO have never been assessed in a sufficiently powered randomised trial. We aimed to determine whether low-dose UFH or therapeutic low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) is non-inferior to standard-dose UFH in patients receiving ECMO.
abstract.textZh: 在接受體外膜氧合（ ECMO ）的患者中，標準做法是全劑量靜脈注射未分割肝素（ UFH ） ，針對基線的活化部分凝血活酶時間為2 · 0-2 · 5倍，以降低血栓形成風險。與低劑量UFH相比，這種方法可以增加出血而不會進一步減少血栓形成。缺乏引導抗凝目標的有力證據，因為ECMO中的抗凝目標從未在充足功率的隨機試驗中進行過評估。我們旨在確定接受ECMO的患者中，低劑量UFH或治療性低分子量肝素(LMWH)是否不劣於標準劑量UFH。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this open-label, three-arm, randomised, non-inferiority trial at seven Dutch intensive care units (ICUs), adults aged 18 years or older supported with veno-venous or veno-arterial ECMO at the ICU without vital indication for full-dose anticoagulation (eg, mechanical mitral valve) were randomly assigned to intravenous standard-dose UFH (activated partial thromboplastin time 2·0-2·5 times baseline), intravenous low-dose UFH (1·5-2·0 times baseline), or therapeutic subcutaneous LMWH. The primary outcome was a composite of severe bleeding during ECMO support, severe thromboembolic complications during ECMO support, or all-cause mortality at 6 months, and was assessed in all randomly assigned patients with deferred informed consent and 6-month follow-up data according to the intention-to-treat principle. Non-inferiority was met if the upper 95% CI limit for the absolute risk difference was less than 7·5 percentage points. This trial is registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04536272) and the Dutch trial register (NL7976).
abstract.textZh: 在這項在七個荷蘭重症監護病房（ ICU ）進行的開放標籤、三組、隨機、非劣效性試驗中，在ICU使用靜脈或靜脈動脈ECMO支援的18歲或以上的成年人，沒有全劑量抗凝的重要適應症（例如，機械二尖瓣） ，被隨機分配到靜脈標準劑量UFH （活化部分凝血活酶時間2 · 0-2 · 5次基線）、靜脈低劑量UFH （ 1 · 5-2 · 0次基線）或治療性皮下LMWH。 主要結果是ECMO支援期間嚴重出血、ECMO支援期間嚴重血栓栓塞併發症或6個月全因死亡率的綜合結果，並根據意向治療原則在所有隨機分配的延遲知情同意書和6個月隨訪數據的患者中進行評估。 如果絕對風險差異的95% CI上限小於7.5個百分點，則符合非劣效性。 本試驗在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT04536272 ）和荷蘭試驗註冊處（ NL7976 ）註冊。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Oct 22, 2020, and Sept 12, 2024, 330 patients were enrolled: 110 were randomly assigned to standard-dose UFH, 110 to low-dose UFH, and 110 to LMWH. Of 330 enrolled patients, 320 (225 [70%] males, 95 [30%] females; median age 56 years [IQR 45-65]; 255 [80%] White ethnicity) were analysed at 6 months. The composite primary outcome occurred in 87 (81%) of 107 patients with standard-dose UFH, 78 (72%) of 108 with low-dose UFH (absolute risk difference -9·1 percentage points [95% CI -20·3 to 2·1]), and 79 (75%) of 105 with LMWH (-6·1 percentage points [-17·2 to 5·0]), meeting non-inferiority for both interventions. The frequency of severe bleeding was lower with low-dose UFH and LMWH than with standard-dose UFH (63 [58%] patients and 62 [59%] vs 70 [65%]), without excess severe thromboembolic complications (11 [10%] and nine [9%] vs 12 [11%]), although these differences did not reach statistical significance. At 6 months, 54 (50%) patients in the standard-dose UFH group, 45 (42%) in the low-dose UFH group, and 46 (44%) in the LMWH group had died.
abstract.textZh: 在2020年10月22日至2024年9月12日期間，招募了330名患者： 110名隨機分配到標準劑量UFH ， 110名分配到低劑量UFH ， 110名分配到LMWH。 在330名入組患者中，在6個月時分析了320名（ 225名[70%]男性， 95名[30%]女性；中位年齡56歲[IQR 45-65] ； 255名[80%]白種人）。 綜合主要結果發生在107名標準劑量UFH患者中的87名（ 81% ）、108名低劑量UFH患者中的78名（ 72% ） （絕對風險差異-9 · 1個百分點[95% CI -20 · 3至2 · 1] ）和105名LMWH患者中的79名（ 75% ） （ -6 · 1個百分點[-17 · 2至5 · 0] ） ，符合兩種幹預措施的非劣效性。 低劑量UFH和LMWH的嚴重出血頻率低於標準劑量UFH （ 63 [58%]名患者和62 [59%]對70 [65%] ） ，沒有過度的嚴重血栓栓塞併發症（ 11 [10%]和9 [9%]對12 [11%] ） ，儘管這些差異沒有達到統計學意義。 在6個月時，標準劑量UFH組的54 （ 50% ）名患者、低劑量UFH組的45 （ 42% ）名患者和LMWH組的46 （ 44% ）名患者死亡。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Low-dose UFH and therapeutic LMWH were non-inferior to standard-dose UFH. This finding supports reconsideration of anticoagulation targets in ECMO. Given the global expansion of ECMO, these findings suggest that reduced anticoagulation targets could substantially reduce bleeding-related harm.
abstract.textZh: 低劑量UFH和治療性LMWH不劣於標準劑量UFH。這一發現支持重新考慮ECMO中的抗凝靶標。鑑於ECMO的全球擴張，這些研究結果表明，降低抗凝目標可以顯著減少出血相關的傷害。

articles.title: Inherited retinal degenerations: clinical phenotypes and emerging therapies
articles.authors: Uyhazi KE, O'Neil EC, Aleman TS, Cideciyan AV

abstract.text: Inherited retinal degenerations are a diverse group of genetic disorders that result in progressive vision loss. Advances in genetic testing have revealed pathogenic variants in hundreds of genes, reflecting the remarkable heterogeneity of these conditions and pointing to the complexity of the developmental and homoeostatic processes needed for a lifetime of good vision. This Review summarises the clinical presentation of inherited retinal degenerations, outlines broad disease categories based on the primary type of retinal cell affected, and highlights novel treatment approaches including gene, cell, optogenetic, and implantable chip therapies. Prompt referral of patients to eye care professionals is essential for early and accurate diagnoses, coordinated care, and optimal visual outcomes.
abstract.textZh: 遺傳性視網膜退化是一組多樣化的遺傳性疾病，會導致進行性視力喪失。基因檢測的進展揭示了數百種基因的致病性變異，反映了這些疾病的顯著異質性，並指出了終身良好視力所需的發育和同質化過程的複雜性。本綜述總結了遺傳性視網膜變性的臨牀表現，根據受影響的視網膜細胞的主要類型概述了廣泛的疾病類別，並強調了新的治療方法，包括基因、細胞、光遺傳和植入式芯片療法。迅速將患者轉介給眼科護理專業人員對於早期準確診斷、協調護理和最佳視力結果至關重要。

articles.title: Dual mobility versus standard cups in total hip replacement for displaced femoral neck fractures (Duality): an international, multicentre, randomised, controlled, superiority trial
articles.authors: Hailer NP, Griffin XL, Mukka S, Lakic TG, Appelbe D, Sköldenberg O, Lamb SE, Östlund O, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Dislocation is the most common early surgical complication in patients with hip fractures treated with total hip replacement (THR). Dual mobility total hip replacement (DM-THR) was developed to increase joint stability, but no randomised trial has investigated its efficacy and safety. We aimed to compare the risk of dislocation in patients receiving DM-THR versus conventional THR.
abstract.textZh: 脫臼是全髖關節置換術(THR)治療的髖部骨折患者最常見的早期手術併發症。雙移動全髖關節置換術（ DM-THR ）旨在提高關節穩定性，但沒有隨機試驗研究其有效性和安全性。我們旨在比較接受DM-THR的患者與傳統THR患者的脫臼風險。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We included people aged 65 years or older with a displaced femoral neck fracture attending 20 Swedish and 24 UK hospitals in this pragmatic, registry-based, randomised superiority trial. Participants eligible for THR were randomly allocated in a 1:1 ratio to either DM-THR or standard THR with the use of remote, web-based, country-specific sequences. Neither participants nor members of the direct clinical care teams were masked, but research investigators and statisticians were masked until the trial analysis was completed. The primary outcome was dislocation of the index joint, treated with closed reduction or open surgery within 1 year, analysed in the modified intention-to-treat population including all consenting participants receiving any type of hip replacement and excluding those with major protocol deviations. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT03909815) and ISRCTN11895196.
abstract.textZh: 我們在這項務實、以註冊表為基礎的隨機優勢試驗中，納入了在20家瑞典醫院和24家英國醫院就診的65歲或以上的股骨頸部移位性骨折患者。符合THR資格的參與者以1 ： 1的比例隨機分配到DM-THR或標準THR ，使用遠程、基於網絡的國家特定序列。參與者和直接臨牀護理團隊的成員都沒有被遮蔽，但在試驗分析完成之前，研究人員和統計學家都被遮蔽。主要結果是指標關節脫臼，在1年內進行封閉性縮減或開放性手術治療，在修改的意圖治療人羣中進行分析，包括接受任何類型髖關節置換術的所有同意參與者，並排除具有重大計畫書偏離的參與者。本試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT03909815)和ISRCTN11895196註冊。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Jan 9, 2020, and April 2, 2024, 2934 eligible patients were screened, of whom 1334 were not enrolled, mainly due to surgeon's preference (n=560), because they had already been treated at the time of screening (n=257), or because informed consent was not obtained (n=213). 1600 participants (64% female, 36% male) were thus randomly assigned to either DM-THR (n=798) or THR (n=802). After exclusion of 34 participants due to prespecified protocol deviations, 1566 participants (97·9%) contributed to the modified intention-to-treat analysis. A dislocation, the primary outcome, occurred in ten (1·3%) of 779 participants in the DM-THR group and in 33 (4·2%) of 787 in the THR group (adjusted hazard ratio 0·27, 95% CI 0·13-0·56; p<0·0001).
abstract.textZh: 在2020年1月9日至2024年4月2日期間，篩選了2934名符合資格的患者，其中1334名未入組，主要是由於外科醫生的偏好（ n = 560 ） ，因為他們在篩選時已經接受過治療（ n = 257 ） ，或者因為未獲得知情同意（ n = 213 ）。因此， 1600名參與者（ 64 ％女性， 36 ％男性）被隨機分配到DM-THR （ n = 798 ）或THR （ n = 802 ）。由於預先指定的方案偏離而排除34名參與者後， 1566名參與者（ 97.9 ％ ）對修改的意向治療分析做出了貢獻。主要結果脫臼發生在DM-THR組779名參與者中的10名（ 1.3 ％ ）和THR組787名參與者中的33名（ 4.2 ％ ） （調整風險比0.27 ， 95 ％ CI 0.13-0.56 ； p < 0.0001 ）。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: The use of DM-THR substantially reduced the risk of dislocation and of any surgical complication among people treated with THR after a displaced femoral neck fracture. DM-THR can thus be recommended for this group of patients.
abstract.textZh: 在股骨頸部骨折後接受THR治療的人羣中，使用DM-THR大大降低了脫臼和任何手術併發症的風險。因此， DM-THR可以推薦給這類患者。

articles.title: Metabolic traits in obesity and normal BMI in industrialised countries: a multi-country analysis of national population-based studies
articles.authors: NCD Risk Factor Collaboration (NCD-RisC)

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Effective treatments are available for obesity and for hypertension and hypercholesterolaemia, which mediate the cardiovascular and renal effects of obesity. Our aim was to compare blood pressure, cholesterol, and the use of antihypertensive and lipid-lowering medicines in people with obesity and normal weight and assess whether the BMI-associated excess risk has diminished.
abstract.textZh: 有效的治療方法可用於肥胖、高血壓和高膽固醇血症，介導肥胖對心血管和腎臟的影響。我們的目標是比較肥胖和體重正常人羣的血壓、膽固醇以及抗高血壓和降脂藥物的使用情況，並評估與BMI相關的過度風險是否已經降低。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: Our primary outcomes were mean systolic blood pressure (SBP), non-HDL cholesterol and HDL cholesterol, and the proportion of the participants who used antihypertensive and lipid-lowering medicines. We used data from 110 health surveys conducted from 1990 to 2024 with 978 425 participants aged 20-79 years sampled from national populations of seven countries: Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, Finland, England, and the USA. We used graphical presentation and trend analysis to evaluate changes over time in these outcomes in participants in the normal BMI range (20·0 to <25·0 kg/m2), and changes in the difference between participants with obesity (separately for class I obesity [30·0 to <35·0 kg/m2] and class II and III obesity [BMI ≥35·0 kg/m2]) or overweight (25·0 to <30·0 kg/m2) and those in the normal BMI range.
abstract.textZh: 我們的主要結果是平均收縮壓（ SBP ）、非HDL膽固醇和HDL膽固醇，以及使用抗高血壓和降脂藥物的參與者比例。我們使用了1990年至2024年進行的110項健康調查的數據，其中978 425名參與者年齡在20-79歲之間，他們來自七個國家的國家人口：日本、韓國、臺灣、泰國、芬蘭、英國和美國。我們使用圖形呈現和趨勢分析來評估正常BMI範圍（ 20 · 0至< 25 · 0 kg/m2 ）參與者這些結果隨時間的變化，以及肥胖參與者（分別為I級肥胖[30 · 0至< 35 · 0 kg/m2]和II級和III級肥胖[BMI ≥ 35 · 0 kg/m2] ）或超重（ 25 · 0至< 30 · 0 kg/m2 ）與正常BMI範圍內的參與者之間的差異。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Mean non-HDL cholesterol and SBP declined over time, especially among those older than 40 years, with the notable exception of some sex-age groups in Thailand. When pooled across all countries, age groups, and obesity and overweight BMI ranges, the difference in mean non-HDL cholesterol with normal BMI became smaller by -0·05 mmol/L per decade (95% CI -0·07 to -0·03) for females and -0·07 mmol/L per decade (-0·09 to -0·05) for males. For SBP, the pooled estimate of change in the difference with normal BMI across all countries, age groups, and obesity and overweight BMI ranges was -0·7 mmHg per decade (95% CI -1·0 to -0·4) for females and -0·6 mmHg per decade (-0·9 to -0·4) for males. The declines were larger in individuals with obesity, especially class II and III obesity, than in normal BMI, leading to a convergence of these risk factors between obesity and normal BMI in people older than 40 years. As a result of these trends, in England, the USA, Thailand, South Korea, and Japan, older people with obesity often became indistinguishable from, or better off than, those with normal BMI in terms of non-HDL cholesterol and SBP. These trends accompanied a larger increase in the use of lipid-lowering and antihypertensive medicines in middle-aged and older people with obesity than in those with normal BMI. The pooled estimate for the increase in difference in lipid-lowering medicines compared with normal BMI across all countries, age groups, and obesity and overweight BMI ranges was 1·5 percentage points per decade (1·0-2·1) for females and 1·6 percentage points per decade (1·0-2·2) for males. For antihypertensive medicines, the pooled estimate was 0·7 percentage points per decade (0·3-1·0) for females and 2·0 percentage points per decade (1·3-2·8) for males. Mean HDL cholesterol increased more in people with normal BMI than those with obesity, leading to a divergence. For people younger than 40 years, there has been little change in the gap between those with obesity or overweight and those with normal BMI; young adults were rarely treated for high cholesterol or blood pressure regardless of their BMI.
abstract.textZh: 平均非HDL膽固醇和SBP隨著時間的推移而下降，特別是在40歲以上的人羣中，除了泰國的一些性別年齡組。 當在所有國家、年齡組、肥胖和超重BMI範圍內進行匯總時，具有正常BMI的非HDL膽固醇平均差異變得較小，女性為每十年-0.05 mmol/L （ 95% CI -0.07至-0.03 ） ，男性為每十年-0.07 mmol/L （ -0.09至-0.05 ）。 對於收縮壓，所有國家、年齡組、肥胖和超重BMI範圍與正常BMI差異的匯總估計值為女性每十年-0.7 mmHg （ 95% CI -1.0至-0.4 ） ，男性每十年-0.6 mmHg （ -0.9至-0.4 ）。 肥胖個體（特別是II級和III級肥胖）的下降幅度大於正常BMI ，導致40歲以上人羣肥胖和正常BMI之間的這些風險因素趨同。 由於這些趨勢，在英國、美國、泰國、韓國和日本，肥胖的老年人在非HDL膽固醇和SBP方面往往與BMI正常的老年人無法區分或更好。 這些趨勢伴隨著肥胖的中年人和老年人使用降脂和抗高血壓藥物的增加大於BMI正常的人。 所有國家、年齡組、肥胖和超重的降脂藥物與正常BMI差異增加的匯總估計值

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: In industrialised countries, blood pressure and non-HDL cholesterol in older adults with obesity are increasingly similar to those with normal BMI, with higher use of antihypertensive and lipid-lowering medicines a possible driver of this convergence. There is nonetheless heterogeneity across countries in the extent of convergence. Young adults with obesity remain metabolically at higher risk than their counterparts with normal weight.
abstract.textZh: 在工業化國家，肥胖老年人的血壓和非HDL膽固醇與BMI正常的血壓和非HDL膽固醇越來越相似，高使用抗高血壓和降脂藥物可能是這種收斂的驅動因素。儘管如此，各國之間在融合程度上存在異質性。與體重正常的年輕人相比，肥胖的年輕人的新陳代謝風險仍然較高。

articles.title: Antiretroviral Therapy
articles.authors: Gulick RM

abstract.text: The development of effective treatment strategies for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection is a major achievement. Antiretroviral drugs inhibit key steps in the viral replication cycle and consist of six mechanistic classes: HIV entry inhibitors, reverse-transcriptase inhibitors (both nucleosides and nonnucleosides), capsid inhibitors, integrase inhibitors, and protease inhibitors. Antiretroviral therapy (ART) suppresses viral replication, thereby enhancing immune function, decreasing morbidity and mortality, and preventing viral transmission. Consequently, ART is recommended for all persons with HIV infection. On the basis of randomized clinical trials, the Food and Drug Administration has approved 36 antiretroviral drugs for the treatment of HIV infection since 1987; of these, 28 are currently available in the United States, and combination ART regimens are used. Initial preferred ART regimens are potent, convenient, and unlikely to cause side effects and consist of an HIV integrase inhibitor with a high barrier to resistance combined with one or two nucleoside reverse-transcriptase inhibitors. In the majority of patients using current ART regimens, viral replication is durably suppressed below detectable levels. Patients receiving ART are monitored for virologic response over time, and if virologic failure occurs, the next regimen is selected on the basis of treatment history and the results of drug-resistance testing; often, antiretroviral drugs from new classes are administered. Today, the life expectancy of someone with HIV infection who consistently takes ART approaches that of the general population.
abstract.textZh: 制定有效的人類免疫缺陷病毒（ HIV ）感染治療策略是一項重大成就。 抗逆轉錄病毒藥物抑制病毒複製週期的關鍵步驟，由六個機制類別組成： HIV進入抑制劑、逆轉錄酶抑制劑（核苷和非核苷）、衣殼抑制劑、整合酶抑制劑和蛋白酶抑制劑。 抗逆轉錄病毒療法（ ART ）抑制病毒複製，從而增強免疫功能，降低發病率和死亡率，並防止病毒傳播。 因此，建議所有HIV感染者使用ART。 在隨機臨牀試驗的基礎上，美國食品藥物管理局自1987年以來已批準36種抗逆轉錄病毒藥物用於治療HIV感染;其中28種目前在美國可用，並使用聯合ART方案。 最初的首選ART方案是有效、方便且不太可能引起副作用，並且由具有高抗性屏障的HIV整合酶抑制劑與一種或兩種核苷逆轉錄酶抑制劑組合而成。 在使用目前ART方案的大多數患者中，病毒複製被持久抑制在可檢測的水平以下。 隨著時間的推移，對接受ART的患者進行病毒學反應監測，如果發生病毒學失敗，則根據治療史和耐藥性測試的結果選擇下一個方案；通常，來自新藥的抗逆轉錄病毒藥物

articles.titleZh: 抗逆轉錄病毒治療

articles.title: Meningococcal B Vaccine to Prevent Neisseria gonorrhoeae Infection
articles.authors: Seib KL, Donovan B, Jin F, Thng C, Yeung B, Comninos N, Bopage RI, Ray A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: No vaccines are currently licensed for the prevention of Neisseria gonorrhoeae infection. Observational studies suggest that the four-component meningococcal serogroup B vaccine (4CMenB) may reduce the risk of gonorrhea.
abstract.textZh: 目前沒有任何疫苗獲準用於預防淋病奈瑟菌感染。觀察研究表明，四組分腦膜炎球菌B型血清疫苗（ 4CMenB ）可能降低淋病風險。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial, we assigned, in a 1:1 ratio, men who have sex with men (MSM) to receive two doses of 4CMenB or placebo. All the participants had recently received a diagnosis of N. gonorrhoeae infection or infectious syphilis and either tested negative for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and were receiving HIV preexposure prophylaxis or were living with HIV. Screening for sexually transmitted infections, including N. gonorrhoeae nucleic acid amplification testing of samples obtained from urogenital, anorectal, and oropharyngeal sites, was performed quarterly for 2 years. The primary outcome was a first N. gonorrhoeae infection after the receipt of vaccine or placebo in the per-protocol population (participants who received both 4CMenB or placebo doses, attended at least two scheduled follow-up visits after the second dose, and did not meet any exclusion criterion pertinent to the assessment of efficacy).
abstract.textZh: 在這項多中心、雙盲、隨機、安慰劑對照試驗中，我們以1: 1的比例分配男男性接觸者(MSM)接受兩劑4CMenB或安慰劑。所有參與者最近都接受了淋病奈瑟菌感染或傳染性梅毒的診斷，並且要麼人類免疫缺陷病毒（ HIV ）檢測呈陰性，要麼正在接受HIV暴露前預防或感染HIV。篩選性傳播感染，包括對從泌尿生殖器、肛門直腸和口咽部位獲得的樣本進行淋病奈瑟氏菌核酸擴增測試，每季進行一次，為期2年。在符合方案的人羣中，主要結果是接受疫苗或安慰劑後的首次淋病奈瑟菌感染（接受4CMenB或安慰劑劑量，在第二次劑量後至少進行兩次預定的追蹤回診，且不符合與療效評估相關的任何排除標準的受試者）。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: From July 2021 through May 2023, a total of 654 participants underwent randomization, of whom 587 were included in the primary analysis. The incidence of N. gonorrhoeae infection was 48.1 events per 100 person-years (160 events among 296 participants) in the 4CMenB group and 47.8 events per 100 person-years (155 events among 291 participants) in the placebo group (incidence rate ratio, 1.01; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.80 to 1.26; P = 0.97), for a vaccine efficacy of -0.5% (95% CI, -26.2 to 19.9). Vaccine efficacy was 5.5% (95% CI, -56.0 to 42.8) for symptomatic infection, -6.4% (95% CI, -47.5 to 23.2) for asymptomatic infection, and -20.0% (95% CI, -90.2 to 23.9), -1.2% (95% CI, -33.0 to 23.0), and 2.6% (95% CI, -27.7 to 25.7) for urogenital, anorectal, and oropharyngeal infection, respectively. Serious adverse events occurred in 4.7% of the participants in the 4CMenB group and in 2.8% of those in the placebo group.
abstract.textZh: 從2021年7月到2023年5月，共有654名參與者接受了隨機分組，其中587人被納入主要療效分析。淋病奈瑟菌感染的發生率在4CMenB組中為每100人年48.1例（ 296名參與者中有160例） ，在安慰劑組中為每100人年47.8例（ 291名參與者中有155例） （發生率比率， 1.01 ； 95%可信區間[CI] ， 0.80至1.26 ； P = 0.97 ） ，疫苗有效性為-0.5% （ 95% CI ， -26.2至19.9 ）。症狀性感染的疫苗有效性為5.5% （ 95% CI ， -56.0至42.8 ） ，無症狀性感染的疫苗有效性為-6.4% （ 95% CI ， -47.5至23.2 ） ，泌尿生殖器、肛門直腸和口咽感染的疫苗有效性為-20.0% （ 95% CI ， -90.2至23.9 ）、-1.2% （ 95% CI ， -33.0至23.0 ）和2.6% （ 95% CI ， -27.7至25.7 ）。4CMenB組中4.7%的參與者發生嚴重不良事件，安慰劑組中2.8%的參與者發生嚴重不良事件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: 4CMenB did not result in a lower incidence of N. gonorrhoeae infection than placebo among MSM who were at high risk for gonorrhea. (Funded by the Australian National Health and Medical Research Council and GSK; GoGoVax ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04415424.).
abstract.textZh: 在淋病高風險的MSM中， 4CMenB並未導致淋病奈瑟菌感染的發生率低於安慰劑。（由澳大利亞國家衛生和醫學研究委員會和葛蘭素史克資助； GoGoVax ClinicalTrials.gov編號為NCT04415424 ）。

articles.titleZh: 預防淋病奈瑟菌感染的腦膜炎球菌B疫苗

articles.title: Daraxonrasib or Chemotherapy in Previously Treated Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer
articles.authors: O'Reilly EM, Wainberg ZA, Hendifar AE, Borad MJ, Pietrantonio F, Pant S, Hammel P, Cremolini C, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Current therapies offer limited benefit for patients with previously treated metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC). Aberrant activation of the RAS pathway is the key driver of PDAC, with oncogenic RAS mutations present in more than 90% of cases. Daraxonrasib is an oral RAS(ON) multiselective, tri-complex inhibitor of the active guanosine triphosphate-bound state of mutant and wild-type RAS.
abstract.textZh: 目前的療法對先前治療過的轉移性胰臟導管腺癌(mPDAC)患者的效益有限。RAS途徑的異常活化是PDAC的關鍵驅動因素，超過90%的病例存在致癌RAS突變。Daraxonrasib是突變型和野生型RAS的活性鳥苷三磷酸結合狀態的口服RAS （ ON ）多選擇性三複合物抑制劑。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 3, international, open-label, randomized trial, we randomly assigned patients with previously treated mPDAC to receive daraxonrasib or chemotherapy of the investigator's choice. The dual primary end points were overall survival and progression-free survival in the subpopulation of patients with RAS G12 mutations (the RAS G12 population). Key secondary end points included overall survival and progression-free survival in the overall population (which included patients with RAS G12, G13, or Q61 mutations or with no RAS mutation identified) and objective response and patient-reported quality of life in the RAS G12 and overall populations. Safety was also assessed.
abstract.textZh: 在這項3期國際、開放標籤、隨機試驗中，我們隨機分配先前接受mPDAC治療的患者接受研究者選擇的daraxonrasib或化療。雙重主要終點是RAS G12突變患者亞羣（ RAS G12族羣）的總生存期和無惡化生存期。關鍵次要終點包括總族羣（包括具有RAS G12、G13或Q61突變或未識別出RAS突變的患者）中的總生存期和無惡化生存期，以及RAS G12和總族羣中的客觀反應和患者報告的生活品質。也評估了安全性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 500 patients, including 91.8% with RAS G12 mutations, were randomly assigned to receive daraxonrasib (248 patients) or chemotherapy (252 patients). The median overall survival in the RAS G12 population was 13.2 months with daraxonrasib and 6.6 months with chemotherapy, and the median overall survival in the overall population was 13.2 months and 6.7 months, respectively; the hazard ratio was 0.40 in both populations (P<0.001). The median progression-free survival in the RAS G12 population was 7.3 months with daraxonrasib and 3.5 months with chemotherapy, and that in the overall population was 7.2 months and 3.6 months, respectively; the hazard ratios were 0.45 and 0.49, respectively (P<0.001 for both comparisons). Adverse events that occurred after the start of treatment were reported in all the patients in the daraxonrasib group and in 97.7% of those in the chemotherapy group; the incidence of adverse events of grade 3 or higher was 61.8% and 69.6%, respectively. Treatment-related adverse events that led to treatment discontinuation occurred in 1.2% of the patients in the daraxonrasib group and in 11.2% of those in the chemotherapy group.
abstract.textZh: 共有500名患者，包括91.8%的RAS G12突變，被隨機分配接受daraxonrasib （ 248名患者）或化療（ 252名患者）。 RAS G12族羣中daraxonrasib的中位總生存期為13.2個月，化療為6.6個月，整體族羣的中位總生存期分別為13.2個月和6.7個月；兩個族羣的風險比為0.40 (P < 0.001)。 在RAS G12族羣中，使用daraxonrasib的中位無惡化生存期為7.3個月，使用化療的中位無惡化生存期為3.5個月，而在整體族羣中，中位無惡化生存期分別為7.2個月和3.6個月；風險比分別為0.45和0.49 （兩項比較的P < 0.001 ）。 Daraxonrasib組和化療組中97.7%的患者報告了治療開始後發生的不良事件； 3級或以上不良事件的發生率分別為61.8%和69.6%。 導致治療停止的治療相關不良事件發生在daraxonrasib組中1.2%的患者和化療組中11.2%的患者。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with previously treated mPDAC, treatment with daraxonrasib led to significantly longer overall survival and progression-free survival than chemotherapy. (Funded by Revolution Medicines; RASolute 302 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06625320.).
abstract.textZh: 在既往接受過mPDAC治療的患者中，與化療相比，使用daraxonrasib治療導致顯著更長的總生存期和無惡化生存期。（由Revolution Medicines資助； RASolute 302 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT06625320。）。

articles.titleZh: Daraxonrasib或化療用於既往治療的轉移性胰腺癌

articles.title: Mavacamten in Adolescents with Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
articles.authors: Rossano JW, Canter C, Wolf CM, Papez A, Gambra M, Bryant RM, Alejos J, McCulloch M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Approved pharmacologic therapies for pediatric hypertrophic cardiomyopathy are lacking, and surgical intervention may be indicated in patients with left ventricular outflow tract obstruction. The efficacy and safety of mavacamten, a cardiac myosin inhibitor that is available for adults, warrant evaluation in adolescents.
abstract.textZh: 兒童肥厚性心肌病缺乏批準的藥理治療，左心室流出道梗阻患者可能需要手術幹預。mavacamten是一種可供成人使用的心肌球蛋白抑制劑，其有效性和安全性值得在青少年中進行評估。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a phase 3, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial involving symptomatic adolescents (12 to <18 years of age) with New York Heart Association class II or III obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. The patients were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive mavacamten or placebo. The primary end point was the change from baseline to week 28 in left ventricular outflow tract pressure gradient provoked by the Valsalva maneuver.
abstract.textZh: 我們進行了一項3期、雙盲、隨機、安慰劑對照試驗，涉及有症狀的青少年（ 12至< 18歲）與紐約心臟協會II或III級阻塞性肥厚性心肌病。患者以1: 1的比例被隨機分配接受mavacamten或安慰劑。主要終點是由伐氏動作引起的左心室流出道壓力梯度從基線到第28週的變化。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 44 patients underwent randomization; 23 patients (8 [35%] of whom were female) were assigned to mavacamten group, and 21 (5 [24%] of whom were female) were assigned to the placebo group. The mean (±SD) age of the patients was 14.7±1.7 years in the mavacamten group and 14.6±1.7 years in the placebo group, and the mean Valsalva left ventricular outflow tract gradient at baseline was similar in the two groups (78.4±34.1 mm Hg and 80.8±47.4 mm Hg, respectively). At week 28, the least-squares mean change in the Valsalva left ventricular outflow tract gradient was -48.5 mm Hg in the mavacamten group and -0.5 mm Hg in the placebo group (difference, -48.0 mm Hg; 95% confidence interval, -67.7 to -28.3; P<0.001). The incidence of adverse events was similar in the two groups. Two patients in each group had serious adverse events; in the mavacamten group, 1 patient had two episodes of syncope, and another had an inappropriate shock delivered by an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator; in the placebo group, 1 patient had chest pain, and another had depression with suicidal ideation. No patient had a reduction in the left ventricular ejection fraction to less than 50%. No deaths occurred during the trial.
abstract.textZh: 共有44例患者被隨機分組；23例患者（其中8例[35%]為女性）被分配至馬伐卡門組，21例患者（其中5例[24%]為女性）被分配至安慰劑組。馬伐卡門組患者的平均年齡（±標準差）為14.7±1.7歲，安慰劑組患者的平均年齡為14.6±1.7歲，兩組患者基線時的平均Valsalva左心室流出道壓力差相似（分別為78.4±34.1 mmHg和80.8±47.4 mmHg）。在第28週，Mavacamten組Valsalva試驗左心室流出道壓力差的最小平方法平均值變化為-48.5 mmHg，安慰劑組為-0.5 mmHg（差異為-48.0 mmHg；95%信賴區間為-67.7至-28.3；P<0.001）。兩組的不良事件發生率相似。兩組各有2例患者發生嚴重不良事件；Mavacamten組1例患者發生2次暈厥，另1例患者植入式心臟復律去顫器（ICD）發生不適當的電擊；安慰劑組1例患者出現胸痛，另1例患者出現伴隨自殺意念的憂鬱症。所有患者的左心室射血分數均未降至50%以下。試驗期間未發生死亡病例。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among adolescent patients with obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, the reduction in left ventricular outflow tract obstruction was significantly greater with mavacamten than with placebo over a 28-week period. (Funded by Bristol Myers Squibb; SCOUT-HCM ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06253221.).
abstract.textZh: 在患有阻塞性肥厚性心肌病的青少年患者中，在28週期間， mavacamten對左心室流出道阻塞的減少明顯大於安慰劑。（由Bristol Myers Squibb資助； SCOUT-HCM ClinicalTrials.gov編號： NCT06253221 ）。

articles.titleZh: Mavacamten在梗阻性肥厚性心肌病青少年中的應用

articles.title: Oral step-down, optimal drug, and total duration of antibiotic treatment in African children hospitalised with severe community-acquired pneumonia (PediCAP): a factorial randomised controlled trial
articles.authors: Bielicki JA, Clements M, Musiime V, Moore DP, Sidat M, Mulenga V, Mutata C, Nalwanga D, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: WHO recommends 5 days of intravenous antibiotics for children hospitalised with severe community-acquired pneumonia (CAP). We aimed to investigate the safety of a step-down to different oral antibiotics and the shortest effective duration.
abstract.textZh: 世衛組織建議患有嚴重社區性肺炎（ CAP ）的兒童靜脈注射抗生素5天。我們的目標是研究使用不同口服抗生素的安全性和最短有效期。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: PediCAP was an open-label, parallel group, 2 × 5 factorial randomised controlled trial of children aged 2 months to 6 years hospitalised with severe CAP without complicating factors in 13 hospitals across five sub-Saharan African countries. Children weighing 3-30 kg and with point-of-care C-reactive protein of more than 10 mg/L were randomly assigned (5:5:1) to either a step-down from intravenous antibiotics to oral amoxicillin (250 mg) or amoxicillin-clavulanate (co-amoxiclav; 200 mg amoxicillin to 28·5 mg clavulanate) via dispersible tablets twice daily (superiority comparison) for five total (intravenous plus oral) durations (4-8 days; non-inferiority comparison), or a 5-day, fixed-duration, intravenous-only treatment (non-inferiority comparison). Children were stepped down when clinically improved and able to take oral antibiotics. Clinicians could change antibiotics if clinically indicated. The primary outcome was the proportion of readmission or death at day 28 (non-inferiority margin vs intravenous only: +10%). The study was registered with the ISRCTN registry (ISRCTN63115131) and is complete.
abstract.textZh: PediCAP是一項開放標籤、平行組、2 × 5階乘隨機對照試驗，在撒哈拉以南非洲五個國家的13家醫院中，對2個月至6歲的兒童進行嚴重CAP無複雜因素的住院治療。 將體重3-30公斤且即時照護C反應蛋白超過10毫克/升的兒童隨機分配(5: 5: 1)至從靜脈注射抗生素降至口服阿莫西林(250毫克)或克拉維酸阿莫西林(共阿莫西拉夫； 200毫克阿莫西林降至28.5毫克克拉維酸) ，透過分散片每天兩次(優效性比較) ，總共5次(靜脈注射+口服)持續時間(4-8天；非劣效性比較) ，或5天、固定持續時間、僅靜脈注射治療(非劣效性比較)。 兒童在臨牀改善並能夠服用口服抗生素時下臺。 如果有臨牀指徵，臨牀醫生可以更換抗生素。 主要結果是第28天再入院或死亡的比例（非劣效性邊界與僅靜脈注射： +10% ）。 本研究已在ISRCTN註冊處（ ISRCTN63115131 ）註冊並已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Dec 7, 2020, and Aug 14, 2023, 2248 children were screened for eligibility and 1101 were randomly allocated (480 [43·6%] girls and 621 [56·4%] boys). The primary outcome was available in 1055 (95·8%) children. For children in the step-down groups, the mean total antibiotic exposure was 6·0 days (SD 3·5) in the 4-day group, 6·8 days (4·2) in the 5-day group, 7·4 (3·6) in the 6-day group, 8·3 days (3·4) in the 7-day group, and 9·2 days (2·9) in the 8-day group (p<0·0001), with 140 (68·6%) of 204, 151 (76·3%) of 198, 167 (85·2%) of 196, 179 (89·5%) of 200, and 186 (91·6%) of 203, respectively, stepping down within their randomised duration (p<0·0001). Primary outcomes occurred in 33 (6·9%) of 475 in the co-amoxiclav group, 27 (5·6%) of 484 in the amoxicillin group, and six (6·3%) of 96 in the intravenous-only group, with both oral step-down strategies non-inferior to the intravenous-only strategy (upper 95% CIs of 6·0 for co-amoxiclav and 5·7 for amoxicillin) and no evidence of superiority for co-amoxiclav over amoxicillin (adjusted risk difference 1·3% [95% CI -1·8 to 4·4]; p=0·40). Primary outcomes occurred in eight (4·1%) of 194 in the 4-day group, ten (5·3%) of 190 in the 5-day group, 16 (8·5%) of 188 in the 6-day group, 16 (8·3%) of 193 in the 7-day group, and ten (5·2%) of 194 in the 8-day group; all durations were non-inferior to the 8-day group (all upper 95% CIs ≤6·0%). There was no evidence of consistent differences in adverse events for oral antibiotic or duration comparisons. For antibiotic-related or serious adverse events, there was one (1·0%) in the intravenous-only group and 12 (2·5%) in the amoxicillin group (adjusted risk difference -2·3% [95% CI -4·2 to -0·3]; p=0·025), and 16 (3·4%) in the co-amoxiclav group (+0·8% [-1·2 to 2·8]; p=0·42); rates increased with randomised duration (slope estimate +0·9% [0·1 to 1·7]; p=0·032).

articles.title: High-dose chemotherapy followed by autologous stem-cell transplantation versus non-myeloablative consolidation in primary CNS lymphoma (MATRix/IELSG43): a randomised phase 3 trial
articles.authors: Illerhaus G, Ferreri AJM, Wendler J, Binder M, Borchmann P, Hasenkamp J, Stilgenbauer S, Röth A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Consolidation therapy for primary CNS lymphoma (PCNSL) includes high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell transplantation (HCT-ASCT), yet its efficacy compared with non-myeloablative chemoimmunotherapy remains uncertain. This study aimed to provide randomised comparative evidence on the efficacy and safety of thiotepa-based HCT-ASCT versus non-myeloablative R-DeVIC consolidation after uniform MATRix induction in newly diagnosed PCNSL.
abstract.textZh: 原發性中樞神經系統淋巴瘤（ PCNSL ）的鞏固療法包括大劑量化療加自體幹細胞移植（ HCT-ASCT ） ，但與非清髓性化學免疫療法相比，其療效仍不確定。本研究旨在提供關於在新診斷的PCNSL中進行均勻MATRix誘導後，基於硫替帕的HCT-ASCT與非清髓性R-DeVIC鞏固的有效性和安全性的隨機比較證據。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This open-label, randomised, phase 3 trial was conducted across 56 university and academic non-university hospitals with established transplantation facilities in five European countries. Eligible for inclusion were untreated, immunocompetent patients with B-cell PCNSL, aged 18-65 years regardless of Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status, or 66-70 years with ECOG performance status 0-2. Pretreatment corticosteroids were permitted. Exclusion criteria included lymphoma manifestation outside the CNS, and congenital or acquired immunodeficiency. Patients received four cycles of MATRix induction (comprising rituximab, high-dose cytarabine, and thiotepa, in addition to high-dose methotrexate). Patients reaching at least partial response were randomly assigned (1:1) to two cycles of R-DeVIC (rituximab plus dexamethasone, etoposide, ifosfamide, and carboplatin) or HCT-ASCT with carmustine and thiotepa. The primary endpoint was progression-free survival, assessed in the full analysis set (excluding patients with major violations of entry criteria). The safety analysis set contained all randomised patients who initiated therapy. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02531841) and the EU Clinical Trials Register (EudraCT number 2012-000620-17). The study is completed.
abstract.textZh: 這項開放標籤的隨機3期試驗在56家大學和非大學學術醫院進行，這些醫院在五個歐洲國家建立了移植設施。 符合納入資格的是未治療的免疫適能B細胞PCNSL患者，年齡為18-65歲，無論東部腫瘤合作組（ ECOG ）體能狀態如何，或66-70歲， ECOG體能狀態為0-2。 允許使用預治療皮質類固醇。 排除標準包括中樞神經系統外的淋巴瘤表現，以及先天性或後天性免疫缺陷。 患者接受四個週期的MATRix誘導（包括利妥昔單抗、大劑量阿糖胞苷和硫替帕，以及大劑量甲氨喋呤）。 將達到至少部分緩解的患者隨機(1: 1)分配到兩個週期的R-DeVIC (利妥昔單抗加地塞米鬆、依託泊苷、異環磷酰胺和卡鉑)或HCT-ASCT加卡莫司汀和硫替帕。 主要終點是在完整分析集中評估的無惡化存活期（不包括嚴重違反入組標準的患者）。 安全性分析集包含所有開始治療的隨機分組患者。 本研究已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT02531841 ）和歐盟臨牀試驗註冊處（ EudraCT編號2012-000620-17 ）註冊。 研究已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between July 16, 2014, and Aug 31, 2019, 368 patients were enrolled. 346 (94%) patients started induction treatment, and 230 were randomly assigned; 229 patients were analysed (R-DeVIC group, n=115; HCT-ASCT group, n=114). After a median follow-up of 45·3 months, 3-year progression-free survival was significantly superior in the HCT-ASCT group (hazard ratio 0·43 [95% CI 0·27-0·68]; p=0·0003). The 3-year progression-free survival was 78% (95% CI 69-85) in the HCT-ASCT group compared with 51% (41-60) in the R-DeVIC group. The mean number of adverse events per patient was 9·3 (SD 4·4) in the R-DeVIC group and 14·6 (5·8) in the HCT-ASCT group. Fatal serious adverse events following consolidation treatment occurred in two patients in the R-DeVIC group (both acute myeloid leukaemia) and in five patients in the HCT-ASCT group (infections and infestations [n=4], pulmonary embolism [n=1]); all of these events apart from the pulmonary embolism were judged to be possibly related to treatment.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Gastroparesis is a condition of delayed gastric emptying in the absence of gastric outlet obstruction. Based on a 2018 US administrative health insurance claims database study, prevalence of definite gastroparesis (with documented delayed gastric emptying) was 21.5 per 100 000 persons.
abstract.textZh: 胃癱瘓是在沒有胃出口梗阻的情況下胃排空延遲的狀況。根據2018年美國行政健康保險索賠數據庫研究，確定性胃輕癱（有記錄的胃排空延遲）的患病率為每10萬人中有21.5人。

abstract.label: OBSERVATIONS
abstract.text: Gastroparesis, which is caused by reduced contractions of the distal stomach or abnormal pyloric relaxation, is more common among females than males (ratio, 2:1-4:1) and typically causes nausea, vomiting, early satiety, bloating, and abdominal pain or discomfort. In a large US epidemiological study involving 82.6 million patients, the most common causes of gastroparesis were type 2 diabetes (51.7%), postsurgical effects (15%), medication-induced (11.8%), idiopathic (11.3%), type 1 diabetes (5.7%), and other (4.5%). Other risk factors include neurological disorders (eg, Parkinson disease), hypothyroidism, amyloidosis, connective tissue disorders (eg, scleroderma), and viral infections (eg, norovirus, cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, SARS-CoV-2). The 2022 American College of Gastroenterology and the 2025 American Gastroenterological Association (AGA) guidelines define the criterion standard diagnostic test for gastroparesis as gastric emptying scintigraphy with more than 10% gastric retention at 4 hours in patients with symptoms of gastroparesis without mechanical obstruction based on upper endoscopy or abdominal imaging such as computed tomographic (CT) scan. The carbon 13 spirulina stable isotope breath test is also approved for diagnosing gastroparesis by the US Food and Drug Administration. Based on the percentage of gastric retention at 4 hours, gastroparesis is categorized in the 2022 AGA clinical practice update as mild (10%-15%), moderate (16%-35%), or severe (>35%). Treatment includes discontinuation of medications that delay gastric emptying such as opioids, cannabis, anticholinergics, and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists and for patients with diabetes, optimizing glycemic control. First-line therapies according to the AGA 2022 clinical practice update are a small particle diet (food that is blended or chopped into small pieces) that is low in fat and nondigestible fiber and antiemetics (eg, serotonin 5-hydroxytryptamine 3 [5-HT3] receptor antagonists, histamine H1 receptor antagonists) for mild gastroparesis; antiemetics and prokinetics (metoclopramide, erythromycin) for moderate gastroparesis, and liquid diet or jejunal enteral feeding for severe gastroparesis. Severe refractory gastroparesis may be treated with gastric peroral endoscopic myotomy (G-POEM), which involves endoscopic-guided incision of the pylorus sphincter muscle, or gastric electrical simulation, in which an implanted neurostimulator sends electrical pulses to the stomach muscle.

articles.title: Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology Enhanced Prevalence and Incidence Criteria (STROBE EPIC): An Extension of the STROBE Statement
articles.authors: Murthy S, Marchello CS, Hagedoorn NN, Faigan S, Andrews JR, Antillón M, Armah GE, Bentsi-Enchill AD, et al.

abstract.text: Prevalence and incidence are fundamental metrics with numerous applications in epidemiology. The Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE) guideline lacks specific items for reporting studies of disease prevalence or incidence. To address this gap, the STROBE Enhanced Prevalence and Incidence Criteria (STROBE EPIC) extension was developed in accordance with established methods for reporting guideline development. The authors generated an initial list of reporting items, conducted a modified Delphi process, and convened a face-to-face consensus meeting to confirm the need for a STROBE extension and to generate an early version of the checklist. They conducted 2 further Delphi surveys, first extending from typhoid and other invasive salmonelloses to all infectious diseases, and then to noncommunicable diseases and injuries. Finally, experts piloted the checklist on relevant manuscripts to critically assess if it was clear, concise, complete, and free of errors. An executive group curated the checklist after every survey round. The STROBE EPIC checklist comprises 47 items in the domains of title (1 item), abstract (2 items), introduction (1 item), methods (25 items), results (6 items), discussion (7 items), and other information (5 items). STROBE EPIC items address reporting of study design, adjustment factors for underreporting and underdiagnosis, denominator population estimation, case ascertainment methods, factors producing artefactual changes to observed disease prevalence or incidence, limitations of incomplete surveillance coverage, generalizability of short-duration studies, and data availability. The authors anticipate that the STROBE EPIC extension will be used by researchers, authors, modelers, burden-of-disease researchers, peer reviewers, and journal editors to optimize the presentation of epidemiologic evidence to support diverse health policy decisions.

articles.title: Dialysis and the Politics of Self-care: The Enduring Effects of Barriers Imposed on Home Dialysis
articles.authors: Killingsworth LB, Golestaneh L

abstract.text: Home dialysis can offer persons with kidney failure a more individualized, flexible, and independent method of dialysis compared with in-center hemodialysis (ICHD), with similar survival outcomes. Home dialysis is also generally less expensive for payers. Despite its advantages, home dialysis remains significantly underused in the United States, particularly among patients with low socioeconomic status. This article addresses current disparities in access to dialysis by examining the history and politics of home dialysis from the 1960s to the present, drawing on hundreds of archival records from dialysis organizations, for-profit dialysis companies, patient advocacy networks, public media, and congressional hearings. The enactment of the Medicare End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) program in 1972 was a monumental victory not just for patients receiving dialysis but also for the growing dialysis industry. In the first 4 years of the program, the rate of home dialysis among ESRD patients decreased from 43% to 20% as patients increasingly dialyzed at for-profit centers. This decline was attributed to financial disincentives, a changing patient demographic, and increased availability of ICHD. By the mid-1970s, expenses for the ESRD program had grown so high that the government turned to home dialysis as a cost-saving measure. Low-income, marginalized patients soon found themselves at the center of a debate between dialysis companies, nonprofit dialysis organizations, and government officials over who was capable of home dialysis. These debates raised questions about the ethics of for-profit medicine, patient representation in policymaking, and the potential for discrimination in incentive models. Despite implementation of financial incentives for home dialysis in 1978 and 1983, home dialysis remained underused, pointing to greater socioeconomic barriers to home dialysis access and gaps in addressing patient needs.
abstract.textZh: 與中心內血液透析（ ICHD ）相比，家庭透析可以為腎功能衰竭患者提供更個性化、靈活和獨立的透析方法，具有相似的生存結果。 對於付款人而言，家庭透析通常也更便宜。 儘管有優勢，但在美國，家庭透析仍未得到充分利用，特別是在社會經濟地位較低的患者中。 本文透過檢視20世紀60年代至今家庭透析的歷史和政治，從透析組織、營利性透析公司、患者倡導網絡、公共媒體和國會聽證會的數百個檔案記錄中解決了目前在獲得透析方面的差異。 1972年制定的Medicare末期腎病（ ESRD ）計劃不僅是接受透析的患者的巨大勝利，也是不斷增長的透析行業的巨大勝利。 在該計劃的前4年，隨著患者越來越多地在營利性中心進行透析， ESRD患者的家庭透析率從43%下降到20%。 這種下降可歸因於財務抑制、患者人口變化以及ICHD的可用性增加。 到20世紀70年代中期， ESRD計劃的費用變得如此之高，以至於政府將家庭透析作為一種節省成本的措施。 低收入、邊緣化的患者很快就發現自己處於透析公司、非營利透析組織和政府之間辯論的中心

articles.title: Sustaining named GP continuity requires organisational change: comparative implementation analysis in Finland
articles.authors: Tuompo W, Mäkelä J, Timonen M, Auvinen J

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Maintaining doctor-patient relationship continuity remains a challenge in public primary care in Finland and internationally due to general practitioner (GP) workforce pressures and organisational constraints.
abstract.textZh: 由於全科醫生（ GP ）的勞動力壓力和組織限制，維持醫患關係的連續性仍然是芬蘭和國際公共初級保健的挑戰。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To evaluate implementation of a named GP model and explain differences in implementation outcomes between two Finnish primary care units.
abstract.textZh: 評估指定的全科醫生模式的實施情況，並解釋芬蘭兩個初級保健單位之間實施結果的差異。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A quasi-experimental before-after study was conducted in two Finnish primary care units with contrasting organisational settings. Patients were assigned a named GP responsible for non-urgent care. Electronic health record data covering physician consultations over 48 months were analysed.
abstract.textZh: 在兩個芬蘭初級保健單位中進行了準實驗性事前事後研究，組織環境形成對比。患者被指派負責非緊急護理的指定全科醫生。分析了涵蓋48個月內醫師會診的電子健康記錄數據。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: Continuity was measured using the Usual Provider of Care Index (UPC), the St Leonard's Index of Continuity of Care (SLICC), and the Own Patient Ratio (OPR). Implementation outcomes were interpreted using the RE-AIM framework. A segmented Interrupted Time Series (ITS) model was applied to OPR and SLICC, and UPC analysed using a pre-post design.
abstract.textZh: 使用常用護理提供者指數（ UPC ）、聖倫納德護理持續性指數（ SLICC ）和自身患者比率（ OPR ）來測量連續性。實施結果使用RE-AIM框架來解釋。將分段中斷時間序列（ ITS ）模型應用於OPR和SLICC ，並使用後期設計分析UPC。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Named GP continuity was higher in Tuira than in Pudasjärvi across all measures. In Tuira, adoption (OPR 0.88) was high and stable with lower named GP-level variation, while reach (SLICC 0.31) and effectiveness (UPC 0.35) improved but remained modest. Although continuity improved in Pudasjärvi, adoption remained weaker (OPR 0.40), reach lower (SLICC 0.16), and maintenance less stable. Continuity of care with physicians other than the named GP increased more in Pudasjärvi.
abstract.textZh: 在所有措施中， Tuira的命名GP連續性都高於Pudasjärvi。在圖伊拉，採用率（ OPR 0.88 ）高且穩定， GP水平變化較低，而REACH （ SLICC 0.31 ）和有效性（ UPC 0.35 ）有所改善，但仍然適度。雖然Pudasjärvi的連續性有所改善，但採用率仍然較弱（ OPR 0.40 ） ，達到較低（ SLICC 0.16 ） ，維護不太穩定。在Pudasjärvi ，除了指定的全科醫生之外，其他醫生的持續護理增加更多。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: The named GP model was functionally adopted in Tuira but remained largely nominal in Pudasjärvi. Health systems implementing named GP models should prioritise sustained GP presence and organisational alignment to achieve continuity.
abstract.textZh: 命名的GP模型在Tuira功能上採用，但在Pudasjärvi基本上保持名義。實施指定GP模型的衛生系統應優先考慮持續的GP存在和組織一致性，以實現連續性。

articles.title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists and Risk for Ischemic Optic Neuropathy : A Target Trial Emulation
articles.authors: Reynolds KR, O'Malley KM, Roy JA, Dave CV

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: There are few data evaluating the association between glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) and nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION), which constitutes approximately 75% of ischemic optic neuropathy (ION) cases in adults.
abstract.textZh: 幾乎沒有數據評估胰高血糖素樣肽-1受體激動劑（ GLP-1RAs ）和非動脈炎性前部缺血性視神經病變（ NAION ）之間的關聯，這構成了成人缺血性視神經病變（ ION ）病例的大約75 ％。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To estimate the effect of GLP-1RAs versus sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2is) and dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors (DPP4is) on risk for ION.
abstract.textZh: 估計GLP-1RA與鈉葡萄糖共轉運蛋白-2抑製劑（ SGLT2is ）和二肽基肽酶-4抑制劑（ DPP4is ）對離子風險的影響。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Observational emulation of a target trial.
abstract.textZh: 目標試驗的觀察模擬。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Large U.S.-based commercial claims database (January 2017 to December 2022).
abstract.textZh: 大型美國商業理賠數據庫（ 2017年1月至2022年12月）。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Patients aged 18 to 65 years with type 2 diabetes initiating a GLP-1RA, an SGLT2i, or a DPP4i.
abstract.textZh: 18至65歲的2型糖尿病患者開始GLP-1RA、SGLT2i或DPP4i。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: The primary outcome was incident ION as a proxy for NAION. Analyses adjusted for more than 80 covariates using inverse probability of treatment weights, and 18-month cumulative incidence and risk differences (RDs) per 10 000 patients were estimated.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是事件ION作為NAION的代理。使用治療權重的反向概率對超過80個協變量進行調整的分析，並估算每10 000名患者的18個月累計發病率和風險差異（ RD ）。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The 18-month risk for ION was 8.5 versus 5.5 per 10 000 among GLP-1RA users versus SGLT2i users (RD, 3.0 [95% CI, 0.4 to 5.7]) and 7.8 versus 4.2 per 10 000 among GLP-1RA users versus DPP4i users (RD, 3.6 [CI, 1.1 to 6.1]). Corresponding numbers needed to harm were 3333 and 2778, respectively. Among GLP-1RA users, 69 (85.2%) of the 81 ION events occurred in persons older than 50 years and 57 (70.3%) occurred in men. Risk differences were attenuated among metformin monotherapy users (2.0 and 4.1) compared with users of 2 or more diabetes medications (5.7 and 4.0) versus SGLT2is and DPP4is, respectively. Risk differences were higher in men, patients aged 50 years or older, and those with cardiovascular disease or ophthalmic conditions, with minimal differences in women and those younger than 50 years.
abstract.textZh: GLP-1RA使用者與SGLT2i使用者之間的18個月ION風險為8.5與5.5/10 000 （ RD ， 3.0 [95% CI ， 0.4至5.7] ） ， GLP-1RA使用者與DPP4i使用者之間的18個月ION風險為7.8與4.2/10 000 （ RD ， 3.6 [CI ， 1.1至6.1] ）。傷害所需的相應數字分別為3333和2778。在GLP-1RA使用者中， 81例離子事件中有69例（ 85.2 ％ ）發生在50歲以上的人羣中， 57例（ 70.3 ％ ）發生在男性中。二甲雙胍單一治療用戶（ 2.0和4.1 ）與2種或更多糖尿病藥物用戶（ 5.7和4.0 ）與SGLT2is和DPP4is之間的風險差異分別減弱。男性、50歲或以上患者、心血管疾病或眼科疾病患者的風險差異較大，女性和50歲以下患者的風險差異最小。

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS
abstract.text: Diagnostic codes specifically for NAION were lacking. Missing data on key clinical factors (such as body mass index and type 2 diabetes duration) may contribute to residual confounding, leaving uncertainty about whether the observed association is causal.
abstract.textZh: 缺乏專門用於NAION的診斷代碼。缺少關鍵臨牀因素（如體重指數和2型糖尿病持續時間）的數據可能會導致殘留的混淆，使觀察到的關聯是否是因果關係的不確定性。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Use of GLP-1RAs was associated with higher 18-month risk for ION than use of SGLT2is and DPP4is, although absolute risk remained very low. Observed differences may reflect residual confounding.
abstract.textZh: 使用GLP-1RA比使用SGLT2is和DPP4is具有更高的18個月離子風險，儘管絕對風險仍然非常低。觀察到的差異可能反映了殘留的混淆。

articles.title: Modernizing the Regulatory Framework for Dietary Supplements: A Position Paper From the American College of Physicians
articles.authors: Cline K, Beachy MW, Carr PW, Health and Public Policy Committee of the American College of Physicians

abstract.text: In the United States, dietary supplements are regulated as a subcategory of food and therefore are not required to undergo review and approval by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). This inadequate regulatory framework has allowed adulterated and mislabeled products to repeatedly enter the market and poses a health threat to the public. In this position paper, the American College of Physicians offers policy recommendations to bolster the FDA's pre- and postmarket regulatory authority for dietary supplements, standardize dietary supplement terminology and data sharing, and implement changes within the health care system to improve care for patients using dietary supplements.
abstract.textZh: 在美國，膳食補充劑作為食品的一個子類別受到監管，因此不需要經過美國食品和藥物管理局（ FDA ）的審查和批準。這種不充分的監管框架允許摻假和錯誤標籤的產品反覆進入市場，並對公眾構成健康威脅。在這份立場文件中，美國醫師學會提供政策建議，以加強FDA對膳食補充劑的上市前和上市後監管機構，標準化膳食補充劑術語和數據共享，並在醫療保健系統內實施變革，以改善對使用膳食補充劑的患者的護理。

articles.title: Comparative Effectiveness of Glucagon-like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists Versus Oral Agents for Insulin Discontinuation in Type 2 Diabetes : A Target Trial Emulation
articles.authors: Lipska KJ, Zawack K, Yan L, Mutalik P, Li J, Gulanski B, Ioannou GN, Aslan M

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Addition of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) to basal insulin can decrease insulin requirements, but whether it permits insulin discontinuation is unclear.
abstract.textZh: 在基礎胰島素中添加胰高血糖素樣肽-1受體激動劑（ GLP-1RAs ）可以降低胰島素需求，但它是否允許胰島素停藥尚不清楚。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To compare rates of insulin discontinuation among patients with type 2 diabetes (T2D) receiving basal insulin who initiated treatment with a GLP-1RA, sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor (SGLT-2i), or dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitor (DPP-4i) between 2020 and 2022.
abstract.textZh: 比較2020年至2022年間接受基礎胰島素治療的2型糖尿病（ T2D ）患者的胰島素停藥率，這些患者開始使用GLP-1RA、鈉葡萄糖共轉運蛋白-2抑制劑（ SGLT-2i ）或二肽基肽酶-4抑制劑（ DPP-4i ）進行治療。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Target trial emulation.
abstract.textZh: 目標試用模擬。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: U.S. Veterans Health Administration electronic health record (EHR) data.
abstract.textZh: 美國退伍軍人健康管理局電子健康記錄（ EHR ）數據。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Veterans with T2D receiving basal insulin.
abstract.textZh: 接受基礎胰島素的T2D退伍軍人。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Insulin discontinuation, defined as the first gap in insulin prescription fills of 12 months or more over 3 years of follow-up.
abstract.textZh: 胰島素停藥，定義為3年隨訪期間胰島素處方填充12個月或更長時間的第一個間隙。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 8869 matched sets of GLP-1RA (76.6% semaglutide, 15.2% dulaglutide, 7.9% liraglutide, and 0.3% exenatide), SGLT-2i (99.7% empagliflozin), and DPP-4i (95.9% alogliptin) initiators, 63% were 65 years or older, 93% were male, 70% were White, and 48% had a hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) level of 9% or more. Over 3 years of follow-up, 1480 (16.7%) GLP-1RA initiators compared with 1585 (17.9%) SGLT-2i initiators and 1517 (17.1%) DPP-4i initiators discontinued insulin therapy in the intention-to-treat analysis (risk ratio, 0.93 [95% CI, 0.86 to 1.01] and 0.98 [CI, 0.87 to 1.09] for the GLP-1RA arm compared with the SGLT-2i and DPP-4i arms, respectively). Results were not substantively different in a modified per protocol analysis. None of the subgroups showed a comparative advantage of GLP-1RAs with respect to insulin discontinuation over SGLT-2is or DPP-4is.
abstract.textZh: 在8869組匹配的GLP-1RA （ 76.6% semaglutide、15.2% dulaglutide、7.9% liraglutide和0.3% exenatide ）、SGLT-2i （ 99.7% empagliflozin ）和DPP-4i （ 95.9% alogliptin ）引發劑中， 63%為65歲或以上， 93%為男性， 70%為白人， 48%的血紅蛋白A1c （ HbA1c ）水平為9%或以上。在3年的追蹤中， 1480 （ 16.7 ％ ）個GLP-1RA啟動劑與1585 （ 17.9 ％ ）個SGLT-2i啟動劑和1517 （ 17.1 ％ ）個DPP-4i啟動劑在意向治療分析中停止了胰島素治療（ GLP-1RA組與SGLT-2i和DPP-4i組的風險比率分別為0.93 [95 ％ CI ， 0.86至1.01]和0.98 [CI ， 0.87至1.09] ）。修改後的每個計畫書分析結果並無實質差異。與SGLT-2is或DPP-4is相比，沒有任何次組顯示出GLP-1RA在胰島素停藥方面的比較優勢。

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Possible residual confounding; misclassification of exposure and outcome using EHRs may bias associations toward the null.
abstract.textZh: 可能的殘留混淆；使用EHR對暴露和結果進行錯誤分類可能會使關聯偏向空值。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Among veterans with T2D receiving basal insulin therapy, addition of GLP-1RA did not increase the chances of stopping insulin therapy compared with SGLT-2i or DPP-4i therapy.
abstract.textZh: 在接受基礎胰島素治療的T2D退伍軍人中，與SGLT-2i或DPP-4i治療相比，加入GLP-1RA並未增加停止胰島素治療的機會。

articles.title: Glucagon-like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists and Risk for Anterior Ischemic Optic Neuropathy : A Nationwide Cohort Study
articles.authors: Ueda P, Svanström H, Söderling J, Pazzagli L, Wintzell V, Eliasson B, Hviid A, Pasternak B

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: There are concerns about a possible link between glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) and nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION).
abstract.textZh: 人們擔心胰高血糖素樣肽-1受體激動劑（ GLP-1RAs ）和非動脈炎性前部缺血性視神經病變（ NAION ）之間可能存在聯繫。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To examine whether use of GLP-1RAs increases risk for AION, which predominantly comprises NAION.
abstract.textZh: 檢查GLP-1RAs的使用是否會增加AION的風險， AION主要由NAION組成。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Nationwide, register-based, cohort study.
abstract.textZh: 全國性、以登記為基礎的隊列研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Sweden, 2013 to 2024.

abstract.label: PATIENTS
abstract.text: Initiators of GLP-1RAs compared with initiators of sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT-2) inhibitors.
abstract.textZh: 與鈉葡萄糖共轉運蛋白-2 （ SGLT-2 ）抑制劑的起始物相比， GLP-1RA的起始物。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Anterior ischemic optic neuropathy in the national patient register. Adjusted risk differences (RDs) and risk ratios (RRs) were estimated using propensity score weighting.
abstract.textZh: 全國患者登記冊中的前部缺血性視神經病變。使用傾向評分加權估算調整後的風險差異(RD)和風險比率(RR)。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Median follow-up was 1.6 years (IQR, 0.7 to 3.1 years) for GLP-1RA users and 1.5 years (IQR, 0.7 to 2.9 years) for SGLT-2 inhibitor users. Sixty-two of 107 518 GLP-1RA users and 64 of 185 898 SGLT-2 inhibitor users experienced AION. Risks were 0.04% versus 0.02% (RD, 0.02% [95% CI, 0.00% to 0.03%]; RR, 1.93 [CI, 1.00 to 3.73]) at 1 year and 0.12% versus 0.07% (RD, 0.05% [CI, 0.00% to 0.10%]; RR, 1.69 [CI, 0.95 to 3.01]) at 5 years. The differences were substantially attenuated in analyses restricted to patients receiving metformin at baseline (1 year: RD, 0.01% [CI, -0.01% to 0.02%]; RR, 1.40 [CI, 0.64 to 3.05]; 3 years: RD, 0.01% [CI, -0.02% to 0.04%]; RR, 1.24 [CI, 0.68 to 2.26]; 5 years: RD, 0.02% [CI, -0.04% to 0.08%]; RR, 1.23 [CI, 0.65 to 2.33]).

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Few outcome events, unmeasured confounding, and limited generalizability to GLP-1RA users without diabetes.
abstract.textZh: 對於沒有糖尿病的GLP-1RA用戶，結局事件很少、無法測量的混淆，且可泛化性有限。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: The relative risk for AION was higher with GLP-1RA use compared with SGLT-2 inhibitor use in type 2 diabetes. However, absolute risks were small, and the RDs were substantially reduced in analyses restricted to patients receiving metformin to better account for confounding by diabetes severity, suggesting observed increases in risk may reflect residual confounding.
abstract.textZh: 與在2型糖尿病中使用SGLT-2抑制劑相比，使用GLP-1RA時AION的相對風險更高。然而，絕對風險很小，在僅限於接受二甲雙胍的患者的分析中， RD大幅降低，以更好地解釋糖尿病嚴重程度的混淆，這表明觀察到的風險增加可能反映了剩餘的混淆。

abstract.text: Karolinska Institutet, Swedish Society of Medicine, Swedish Research Council, and Region Stockholm.
abstract.textZh: Karolinska Institutet、瑞典醫學學會、瑞典研究委員會和斯德哥爾摩地區。

articles.title: Management and long-term serum urate control in gout: a population-based primary care cohort study
articles.authors: Pou MA, Reyes C, Martinez-Laguna D, Satorra P, Tebe C, Dalbeth N, Diaz-Torne C

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Gout is a prevalent chronic inflammatory disease associated with a substantial clinical and cardiovascular burden. Despite the availability of effective urate-lowering therapies (ULTs), gout management remains suboptimal.
abstract.textZh: 痛風是一種流行的慢性炎症性疾病，伴隨著大量的臨牀和心血管負擔。儘管有有效的降尿酸療法（ ULT ） ，但痛風管理仍然不理想。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To describe clinical characteristics and treatment patterns, and to identify factors associated with long-term serum urate (SU) control in gout.
abstract.textZh: 描述臨牀特徵和治療模式，並確定與痛風中長期血清尿酸（ SU ）控制相關的因素。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Retrospective population-based cohort study using the primary care research database 'Sistema d'Informació per al Desenvolupament de la Investigació en Atenció Primària' (SIDIAP), covering >75% of the Catalan population within a universal healthcare system.
abstract.textZh: 使用初級保健研究資料庫「Sistema d 'Informació per al Desenvolupament de la Investigació en Atenció Primària」（ SIDIAP ）進行的回顧性人羣隊列研究，涵蓋全民醫療系統中> 75%的加泰隆尼亞人口。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Individuals with incident gout diagnosed between 2012 and 2023 were included. Demographic, clinical, and ULT data were collected. Good SU control was defined as SU levels <6 mg/dL for ≥80% of follow-up time. Factors associated with SU control were analysed.
abstract.textZh: 其中包括2012年至2023年間確診為痛風事件的個體。收集了人口統計學、臨牀和ULT數據。良好的SU對照定義為在≥ 80%的追蹤時間內SU濃度< 6 mg/dL。分析了與SU對照相關的因素。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 94 759 patients were included (mean age 66.25 [standard deviation 14.64] years; 79.58% male [75 412/94 759]; median follow-up 5.44 [interquartile range 2.54-8.24] years). In the 94 759 patients, hypertension (65.15%, n = 61 732), dyslipidaemia (50.58%, n = 47 932), diabetes (24.19%, n = 22 919), and chronic kidney disease (32.80%, 27 013/82 270 ) were common. Of the patients, 88.95% (n = 84 288) had ≥1 SU measurement. In total, 37.30% (35 343/94 759) had never received ULT. Allopurinol was the initial therapy in 96.09% of treated patients. Only 12.40% (10 453/84 288) achieved good SU control, with no improvement over time. Short ULT duration (≤25 days) occurred in 15.92% (9459/59 416) of patients. Good control was associated with longer treatment duration, higher allopurinol doses, febuxostat use, and better adherence, whereas delayed ULT initiation, male sex, obesity, chronic kidney disease, dyslipidaemia, and hypertension were associated with poor control.
abstract.textZh: 共入組94 759名患者（平均年齡66.25 [標準差14.64]歲； 79.58%男性[75 412/94 759] ；中位隨訪5.44 [四分位數範圍2.54-8.24]歲）。在94 759名患者中，高血壓(65.15% ， n = 61 732)、血脂異常(50.58% ， n = 47 932)、糖尿病(24.19% ， n = 22 919)和慢性腎臟疾病(32.80% ， 27 013/82 270)很常見。在患者中， 88.95% (n = 84 288)的SU測量值大於或等於1。共有37.30% （ 35 343/94 759 ）從未接受過ULT。別嘌呤醇是96.09%接受治療的患者的初始治療。只有12.40 ％ （ 10 453/84 288 ）取得了良好的SU控制，但隨著時間的推移沒有改善。15.92% (9459/59 416)的患者發生短ULT持續時間(≤ 25天)。良好的控制與更長的治療持續時間、更高的別嘌呤醇劑量、非布司他使用和更好的依從性相關，而延遲的ULT開始、男性、肥胖、慢性腎臟疾病、血脂異常和高血壓與不良的控制相關。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Long-term SU control in gout remains poor in primary care. Early initiation of ULT, appropriate dose optimisation, and improved adherence represent key modifiable targets to improve gout management.
abstract.textZh: 痛風的長期SU控制在初級保健中仍然很差。早期開始ULT、適當的劑量優化和改善的依從性是改善痛風管理的關鍵可修改目標。

articles.titleZh: 痛風的治療和長期血清尿酸控制：一項基於人羣的初級保健隊列研究

articles.title: Impact of treatment duration on the effectiveness of opioid analgesia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
articles.authors: Froentjes LS, Barrington CA, Craig RA, Morcos M, Wedman DM, Korowynk CS, Kelmer MD, Campbell FN, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Opioid use can heighten pain perception over time.
abstract.textZh: 隨著時間的推移，使用鴉片類藥物會增加疼痛感。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To determine whether the effectiveness of opioid analgesia diminishes with treatment duration in those with chronic low back pain or osteoarthritis.
abstract.textZh: 確定在慢性腰痛或骨關節炎患者中，鴉片類止痛藥的有效性是否會隨著治療時間而減少。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Systematic review of randomised trials comparing opioids with placebo/opioid-minimised pain management strategies in those with chronic low back pain or osteoarthritis.
abstract.textZh: 在慢性腰痛或骨關節炎患者中比較鴉片類藥物與安慰劑/鴉片類藥物最小化疼痛管理策略的隨機試驗的系統審查。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: A random-effects meta-analysis using MEDLINE, Embase, CENTRAL, and Scopus databases was undertaken in January 2025. The primary outcome was attainment of clinically important pain relief ('moderate' or ≥30% improvement). The secondary outcome was on-treatment pain (100-point scale). The primary analysis was difference in primary/secondary outcomes across short-term (≤4 weeks), intermediate-term (4-12 weeks), and long-term (≥12 weeks) duration subgroups.
abstract.textZh: 2025年1月，使用MEDLINE、Embase、CENTRAL和SCOPUS資料庫進行了隨機效應薈萃分析。主要結果是實現臨牀上重要的疼痛緩解（「中度」或≥ 30%的改善）。次要結果是治療中疼痛（ 100分量表）。主要療效分析是短期（ ≤ 4週）、中期（ 4-12週）和長期（ ≥ 12週）持續時間次組的主要/次要結果差異。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In total, 27 trials were eligible for inclusion. Clinically important pain relief differed significantly between short-, intermediate-, and long-term treatment durations (P = 0.05). Opioid recipients were more likely to be responders in short-term trials (eight trials, risk ratio [RR] 1.42, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.08 to 1.89, moderate-certainty evidence), but not in intermediate-term trials (three trials, RR 1.04, 95% CI = 0.84 to 1.30, low-certainty evidence), or long-term trials (nine trials, RR 0.91, 95% CI = 0.73 to 1.14, moderate-certainty evidence), which trended in favour of controls. The mean difference in pain scores failed to reach this review's definition of clinical significance (≥10 points) for any timepoint, but was statistically significant in the short and intermediate term.
abstract.textZh: 總共有27項試驗符合納入資格。臨牀上重要的疼痛緩解在短期、中期和長期治療持續時間之間存在顯著差異（ P = 0.05 ）。鴉片類藥物受試者在短期試驗（八項試驗，風險比[RR] 1.42 ， 95%置信區間[CI] = 1.08至1.89 ，中等確定性證據）中更有可能是反應者，但在中期試驗（三項試驗， RR 1.04 ， 95% CI = 0.84至1.30 ，低確定性證據）或長期試驗（九項試驗， RR 0.91 ， 95% CI = 0.73至1.14 ，中等確定性證據）中則不是，這些試驗趨向於支持對照。在任何時間點，疼痛評分的平均差異都無法達到本綜述的臨牀意義定義（ ≥ 10分） ，但在短期和中期具有統計學意義。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Although opioids likely provide meaningful pain relief over short durations (≤4 weeks), they appear to provide little or no benefit beyond placebo over longer periods, and may worsen pain control beyond 12 weeks.
abstract.textZh: 雖然鴉片類藥物可能在短期（ ≤ 4週）內提供有意義的疼痛緩解，但它們似乎在較長時間內除了安慰劑之外幾乎沒有或沒有任何益處，並且可能會在12週後惡化疼痛控制。

articles.titleZh: 治療持續時間對類鴉片止痛有效性的影響：系統回顧和薈萃分析

articles.title: Point-of-care biomarkers or laboratory-based tests to reduce antibiotic prescribing for COPD exacerbations: a literature review and meta-analysis in primary care
articles.authors: Frénois M, Fovet R, Wyts D, Collins C, Calafiore M, Berkhout C

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Acute exacerbations of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD) are frequently treated with antibiotics in primary care, leading to antibiotic resistance and adverse effects. Assessing biomarkers might assist in reducing unnecessary antibiotic prescribing when used alongside clinical assessment.

articles.title: Prolonged Short Sleep and Its Effect on Body Weight and Composition : A Pooled Analysis of Randomized Trials
articles.authors: Zuraikat FM, Scaccia SE, Cochran JA, Cheng B, Diaz KM, Creasy SA, Melanson EL, Shen W, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Insufficient sleep is associated with obesity. However, the causal effect on weight status of chronic, mildly insufficient sleep and its potential variability by gender and menopausal status remain unknown.

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To explore the effect of 6 weeks of sleep restriction (SR) of 1.5 hours per night on energy balance and body weight regulation.

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Pooled analysis of 2 randomized crossover trials. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02960776 and NCT02835261).

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Outpatient intervention with inpatient and outpatient assessments.

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Adults (n = 95) aged 20 years or older at elevated cardiometabolic risk with habitual sleep of 7 or more hours per night.

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: Six weeks of sustained adequate sleep (AS) and SR of 1.5 hours per night separated by a multiweek washout.

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Outcome measures included adiposity (assessed using magnetic resonance imaging), body weight, waist circumference, and energy balance behaviors and biomarkers.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Sleep duration was reduced by 78.4 minutes (95% CI, -83.5 to -73.3 minutes) per night with SR versus AS. Body weight (0.45 kg [CI, 0.33 to 0.57 kg]), waist circumference (0.52 cm [CI, 0.25 to 0.79 cm]), and whole-body volume (0.56 L [CI, 0.19 to 0.93 L]) were increased with SR relative to AS. Leptin levels were elevated with SR versus AS (2.03 ng/mL [CI, 0.38 to 3.68 ng/mL]). Sedentary time was increased by 17.2 minutes (CI, 11.7 to 22.7 minutes) per day with SR versus AS.

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS
abstract.text: The intervention duration may have been too short to identify changes in body composition, power to evaluate individual differences was limited, and effect sizes were modest.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Prolonged exposure to moderately short sleep may lead to weight gain, suggesting that weight management and cardiometabolic disease prevention programs should consider incorporating sleep strategies to promote AS.

abstract.label: PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE
abstract.text: National Institutes of Health and American Heart Association.

articles.title: Patient-Centered Prescription Opioid Tapering Methods : A Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Darnall BD, Perez L, Kao MC, Lorig K, Mardian AS, Flood P, Pun T, Hanson ER, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Evidence is needed on tapering long-term prescription opioids in outpatient settings.

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine and compare the effectiveness of 3 opioid tapering and pain control strategies (July 2018 to November 2023).

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Randomized controlled trial. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03445988).

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: 11 U.S. sites.

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Adults with pain for at least 6 months receiving a morphine equivalent daily dose (MEDD) of 10 or higher for at least 3 months without moderate or severe opioid use disorder.

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: Patient-centered opioid tapering with close monitoring and electronic supports was administered as taper only, taper plus cognitive behavioral therapy for chronic pain (pain-CBT), or taper plus a chronic pain self-management program (CPSMP).

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Taper success (primary outcome) was either an MEDD decrease of at least 50% with no increased pain or no MEDD increase with decreased pain intensity.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 562 participants were randomly assigned (191 taper only, 203 taper plus pain-CBT, 168 taper plus CPSMP). The taper success rate was 50.9% (95% CI, 42.9% to 58.9%) for taper only, 48.6% (CI, 41.0% to 56.2%) for taper plus pain-CBT, and 44.5% (CI, 36.0% to 53.3%) for taper plus CPSMP. Tapering with pain-CBT or CPSMP provided no benefit in taper success over taper only (taper plus pain-CBT vs. taper only, -2.4 percentage points [CI, -11.9 to 7.2 percentage points]; taper plus CPSMP vs. taper only, -5.2 percentage points [CI, -15.3 to 4.8 percentage points]). Study-related adverse event risk (including opioid withdrawal symptoms) was highest in the taper only group (126 of 191 [66%]) compared with taper plus pain-CBT (109 of 203 [54%]) and taper plus CPSMP (108 of 168 [64%]).

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Challenges related to COVID-19 reduced the sample size and made treatment groups imbalanced; low behavioral treatment attendance and losses to follow-up could have limited effectiveness.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Adding CBT or self-management to patient-centered opioid tapering did not improve taper success at 12 months, although CBT may reduce adverse effects (including opioid withdrawal symptoms).

abstract.label: PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE
abstract.text: Patient-Centered Outcomes Research Institute.

articles.title: The Comparative Effectiveness of Carvedilol Versus Other Nonselective β-Blockers in Cirrhosis
articles.authors: Simon TG, Zhang Y, Kehoe A, Chung RT, Lin KJ

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: In cirrhosis, nonselective β-blockers (NSBBs; carvedilol, nadolol, and propranolol) reduce hepatic portal pressure and have demonstrated benefit versus placebo for preventing decompensation. Although carvedilol has emerged as the preferred NSBB, direct evidence remains limited about its effectiveness for preventing decompensation and death versus other NSBBs.

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To compare the effectiveness of carvedilol versus nadolol versus propranolol in cirrhosis.

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Database cohort study.

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: A U.S. administrative claims database, Optum Clinformatics Data Mart (2013 to 2025).

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Adults with cirrhosis initiating carvedilol, nadolol, or propranolol.

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: The primary outcome was a composite of hospitalization for major decompensation (ascites, spontaneous bacterial peritonitis [SBP], hepatorenal syndrome [HRS], hepatic encephalopathy, or variceal hemorrhage). Absolute risk differences (RDs) and risk ratios (RRs) at 6 months of follow-up were estimated using inverse probability of treatment weighting accounting for 129 preexposure covariates.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Carvedilol initiators had meaningfully lower 6-month risk for major decompensation events compared with nadolol (RD, -3.69 percentage points [95% CI, -5.33 to -2.09 percentage points]; RR, 0.80 [CI, 0.72 to 0.88]) or propranolol (RD, -2.88 percentage points [CI, -4.29 to -1.49 percentage points]; RR, 0.83 [CI, 0.76 to 0.90]). This included substantially lower 6-month risk for specific decompensation events with carvedilol compared with nadolol or propranolol, including reduced risk for variceal hemorrhage (RDs, -3.51 percentage points [CI, -4.79 to -2.20 percentage points] and -1.65 percentage points [CI, -2.71 to -0.59 percentage points], respectively) and ascites, SBP, or HRS (RDs, -3.05 percentage points [CI, -4.52 to -1.75 percentage points] and -1.58 percentage points [CI, -2.77 to -0.44 percentage points], respectively).

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Nonrandomized treatment selection.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Among U.S. patients with cirrhosis, carvedilol initiation-as opposed to nadolol or propranolol-was associated with meaningfully lower rates of major decompensation events.

abstract.text: National Institutes of Health.
